description: Application for Non-Material amendment to planning permission ref: PA/22/01947, Dated 22/12/2022.Non Material amendment(s) Sought: Amendment to the wording of Condition 2 (Landscaping) to remove the requirement for all landscaping to be implemented prior to occupation to allow for a temporary landscaping scheme to be implemented whilst othe development plots await development, and amendments to the approved design to allow for the (i). installation of new blade signage to be added to the external walls outside the retail unit on the South, West and North Elevations (ii). Addition of a new inlet cabinet to be added to the louvred panel of the plant room on the South elevation, (iii). Amendments to the escape doors on the east and south elevations to include glazing, and (iv). Revisions of plant equipment and fire egress on the roof
